description: Check a public http(s) URL for an L402, x402, or MPP challenge and for agent discovery files. Two free reports per client per 24 hours, using the same client identification as GET /v1/changes. After that, the tool returns payment info for GET https://api.agentpaywire.com/v1/check and does not run the probe. Private, localhost, and metadata URLs are rejected. url is required. report.protocol is the passing challenge ids in the order l402, x402, mpp, joined with +, or null when none pass.

url.description: Required public http or https URL of the payment endpoint.

name: check_payment_endpoint
title: Check a payment endpoint
